import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    if not s:
        return
    # First character
    s1 = s[0]
    # Rest of string with "dot" replaced by "."
    rest = s[1:].replace("dot", ".")
    s1 += rest
    # Build s2
    s2 = s1[0]
    b = True
    i = 1
    while i < len(s1):
        if b and i <= len(s1) - 2 and s1[i] == 'a' and s1[i+1] == 't':
            s2 += '@'
            i += 2
            b = False
        else:
            s2 += s1[i]
            i += 1
    print(s2)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
